description: This Java source file defines the UploadChanges class, which provides a GUI application and command-line utility for uploading configuration changes to a device via serial port connection. It initializes UI components, manages serial port communication, loads configuration images, and performs the upload operation using binary protocol. It also implements a custom logger that updates the UI with log messages.

classes.name: UploadChanges
classes.description: Main class providing GUI and CLI functionality for uploading configuration images via serial port, initializing UI components, managing serial port communication, and executing upload tasks.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the application; processes command-line arguments, initializes UI, and starts communication.

methods.name: showUi
methods.description: Sets up serial port, loads configuration images, and initializes binary protocol for communication.

methods.name: scheduleUpload
methods.description: Schedules the upload of a new configuration image, optionally with a callback to execute after upload.

methods.name: createUiLogger
methods.description: Creates a Logger implementation that updates UI components with log messages.
